[FMLA 20] ElasticEnergy — Elastic Energy

Potential energy stored in a stretched/compressed spring.

Calculator scroll name: ElasticEnergy. Potential energy stored in a stretched/compressed spring.

formula
U=21​Kx2

A stretched or compressed spring holds energy you can get back. U = ½ K x². x = 0 (unstretched) holds nothing.

keys
FMLA→2→0

Primary inputs: K, x.

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 2, then 0 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

  1. FMLA → 2 → 0
  2. Enter K, x
  3. Elastic energy U
note

SI: K in N/m, x in m (both > 0); energy U in J.
